text:
Maria: Heads-up — BlueHarbor just told CSM they spun up a new Data Science team (8 engineers) and want semantic search + doc summarization. They expect ~2x token volume starting June. cc @Sam for capacity and @Jordan for SE enablement.

Sam: Thanks. They're on Silver plan so no reserved capacity. Short term we can allow a burst but need infra approval for sustained increase. Marking as potential renewal opportunity if onboarding goes well.

Jordan: On it. I'll propose an embeddings + quantized LLM flow. Quick question for Ellen: are the docs mostly PDFs and Confluence pages or a mix including DB extracts?

Ellen (BlueHarbor): Mostly PDFs + internal Confluence pages, some CSV exports. Priority is search relevance for support articles. Want an enablement session for ingestion + eval criteria.

Maria: Good to know. I'll book a 90-min enablement + ingestion workshop week of May 20. Agenda: ingestion checklist, mapping to embeddings, sample prompts, and a production readiness checklist.

Sam: For capacity: short-term burst = up to 3x baseline for 2 weeks — I can approve. Sustained bump needs Dedicated or a monthly commit. I'll open INF ticket to request review for a 6-week ramp.

ops-bot: INF-4521 created by Sam for BlueHarbor capacity review. ETA 48h for infra triage.

Leo: Adding commercial context — this is high intent. If we land the enablement smooth, sales can push for Dedicated which would be ~+$12k ARR. I'll join the enablement call.

Jordan: For the POC, recommend: model=redwood-embed-1 for semantic indexing, and quantized redwood-qlm-2 (int8) for summarization to keep token costs down. Suggest caching top-k embeddings and precomputing doc vectors.

Jordan: Config snippet to share with them:
```
model: redwood-embed-1
vector_dim: 1536
quantize: int8
batch_size: 512
prefetch: true
cache_prefix_kv: true
```

Maria: Ellen — can you share a sample export (10-15 PDFs + a couple Confluence pages) before Friday? We'll use it for the enablement demo.

Ellen (BlueHarbor): Uploaded sample bundle to the shared drive: https://drive.example.com/blueharbor-sample. Please confirm you can access.

Sam: Got it. I also flagged an ops note: if they hit high concurrency on search endpoints, we'll need routing rules to their region to avoid cross-region latency.

Jordan: I'll prepare a short eval plan (precision/recall + latency) and a small prompt suite. Also will include a fallback policy to a lighter model for SLO preservation.

Maria: Perfect. Next steps: Sam to follow up on INF-4521 and quota bump, Jordan to send eval plan + config by Tuesday, Maria to schedule enablement invite, Leo to prep renewal/expansion motion. Ellen to share sample bundle (done). :thumbsup:

Leo: I'll log the opportunity in the CRM and ping account exec for potential commercial packaging.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: enablement invite for May 22 10:00 AM added to channel calendar.

Sam: Once INF-4521 is triaged I'll post the interim quota increase and expected timelines here.

Jordan: Sharing initial eval doc in #eng-ml after the config is finalized.

Maria: Thanks team — tracking this as an expansion signal under BlueHarbor (CSAT: 4.2/5 last touch). Will update the renewal risk if we see any blocker.

Ellen (BlueHarbor): Appreciate the quick responses. Looking forward to the workshop.
